name: Error Auto-Repair (template)
description: TEMPLATE. Set this workflow as another workflow's error workflow (settings.error_workflow = this workflow's id, or `monoagentcli config set workflow.error_workflow <id>` for every workflow). When that workflow fails, a local agent reads the failure and proposes a fix, and a person reviews the proposal. Nothing is changed automatically: apply an approved fix yourself. Set the agent runtime before use.

config.system_prompt: You diagnose failed mono-agent workflow runs. You cannot change anything; you only propose a fix for a person to review.
